mechanism: Both agents may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 enzymes; berberine may increase allopurinol levels through hepatic metabolism inhibition, potentially elevating xanthine oxidase inhibitor concentrations.
action: Monitor for allopurinol toxicity signs (rash, hepatotoxicity); consider dose adjustment of allopurinol if co-administered with berberine, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
